newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee edges up on sluggish dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee edges up on sluggish dollar demand.

text.p: The Indian rupee edged up against the dollar in late Tuesday morning trade on lack of demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The latest dollar quotes are at 35.712/717 against the opening quote of 35.72/73, dealers said.
"The dollar has fallen by one paise," said a dealer.
The State Bank of India was quoting at 35.71/72.
The dollar may test the 35.70-mark on Tuesday unless the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervenes, a dealer said.
